name: Session archive
description: Keeps every prompt, reply, reasoning step and tool call from all your machines in one SQLite file on a hub machine.

archivePath.title: Archive file
archivePath.description: Set this on the hub only. The absolute path of the archive database, such as /srv/archive/klin-sessions.sqlite. Setting it makes this machine the hub.

hubUrl.title: Hub address
hubUrl.description: The hub's address, such as http://homeserver:4790. Other machines send their events there, and the hub listens on its port. Leave it empty on a hub that only archives its own events.

key.title: Shared key
key.description: The same key on every machine, at least 16 characters. The hub refuses events without it.

permissions: Reads every orchestration event this machine stores: prompts, replies, reasoning, tool calls and subagents.
On the hub, writes those events to the archive file set in Archive file.
On the hub, listens on the port in Hub address on every network interface.
On other machines, sends their events to the hub at Hub address.
